_doc: Entry points covered through a group: each member shares the read path of a representative that was checked live (run and case named), by a cited argument. A Private class method has no entry but its callers (the Native API refuses it), and a method with a ByRef/Output array parameter cannot be called over the Native API (an IRISReference for an array parameter crashed the client: smoke log, not registered); their reads happen only inside the representative's call, on the same arguments or on the arguments the representative derives. Delegation groups list wrappers whose body is one call of the target with the same arguments; there both members were also run live.

groups.shared_read_path: Private helpers of the one writer's removals: HeldElsewhere reads ^KG("out", every other graph, s, p, o) only to decide whether the merged ^NKG entry (no graph dimension) is still held; MarkGraphGone reads ^KG("out", pGraph) and ^NKG("$NI") to mark ^NKG stale. Neither result reaches the graph's own ^KG entries.
